title: Failure to boot Hibernate ORM metadata on presence of abstract super entities
body:
**Describe the bug**
After migrating to Quarkus version 1.3.0 from version 1.2.1, there is an error related to hibernate defined entities which results in the following stacktrace after running `mvn clean compile quarkus:dev` which ran successfully before migrating:

Data model is implemented as follows. 
All entities extend `DataIdentity`, which is a `@MappedSuperclass` based on composite key.

```
@MappedSuperclass
@IdClass(IdVersionPK.class)
public abstract class DataIdentity {
    @Id
    @Column(name = "ID")
    private String id;

    @Id
    @Column(name = "VERSION")
    private Long version;

   //getters, setters
}
```

```
public class IdVersionPK implements Serializable {
    @Column(name = "ID")
    @Id
    private String id;
    
    @Column(name = "VERSION")
    @Id
    private Long version;

    //default constructor, getters, setters, equals, hashcode
}
```

The problem appears to be related to the following class which is used as a base class for different types of points:

```
@Entity
@Table(name = "POINT")
@Inheritance(strategy = InheritanceType.JOINED)
@DiscriminatorColumn(name = "POINT_TYPE")
public abstract class PointEntity extends DataIdentity {
    @Column(name = "NAME")
    private String name;

    //getters, setters
}
```

When the `abstract` keyword is removed from PointEntity class definition, no error is thrown. 

Since this is a valid mapping of hibernate entities executed successfully in earlier Quarkus versions, I don't see a reason why this code shouldn't execute successfully in version 1.3.0.

**Expected behavior**
Data model is correct and program runs without errors as in earlier Quarkus version.

**Actual behavior**
Program is not executed successfully and error with earlier mentioned stack trace is thrown. 

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Implement the data model with earlier described entities
2. Setup a database with proper configuration in application.properties
3. Run `mvn clean compile quarkus:dev`

**Configuration**
```properties
quarkus.datasource.url=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/test_db
quarkus.datasource.driver=org.postgresql.Driver
quarkus.datasource.username=test
quarkus.datasource.password=test

```
